name: match-maker
description: Matchmaking for a badminton club's shared weekly match night

scripts.test:rules: npx --yes firebase-tools@15.34.0 emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-matchmaker "vitest run --config vitest.rules.config.ts"
scripts.emulators: sh -c 'npx --yes firebase-tools@15.34.0 emulators:start --only auth,firestore --project demo-matchmaker --export-on-exit .emulator-data $( [ -f .emulator-data/firebase-export-metadata.json ] && echo --import .emulator-data )'
